info.title: Marist Polytechnic - Admissions API
info.description:
Phase 1 admissions backend. Applicant journey (account -> application -> documents -> payment -> submission) and officer review (approve/reject/admit) through a single status state machine.

Auth: obtain a token at POST /api/auth/login/, then click **Authorize** and paste the `access` token (Swagger prepends `Bearer` for you).

post.description:
Issue the final admission decision.

``approved`` records an :class:`AdmissionDecision` (with a public
verification code) and offers admission (``admitted``); ``rejected`` records
the decision and rejects the application. Legality of the status move is
enforced by ``transition`` — e.g. an offer requires the application to be
``approved`` or ``under_review`` first.

get.description: Stream any admitted applicant's admission letter as an inline PDF.
